verses.greek: Παῦλος κλητὸς ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ καὶ Σωσθένης ὁ ἀδελφὸς
verses.literal: Paul a called apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God and Sosthenes the brother
verses.dgt: Paul, called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Sosthenes the brother,

verses.greek: τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ, ἡγιασμένοις ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, τῇ οὔσῃ ἐν Κορίνθῳ, κλητοῖς ἁγίοις, σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐπικαλουμένοις τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ αὐτῶν καὶ ἡμῶν·
verses.literal: To the church the of God sanctified in Christ Jesus which is being in Corinth called holy together with all those calling on the name of the Lord of us Jesus Christ in every place both theirs and ours:
verses.dgt: to the assembly of God that is in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, together with all who in every place call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, both theirs and ours:

verses.greek: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.literal: Grace to you and peace from God Father of us and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.dgt: grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.greek: Εὐχαριστῶ τῷ θεῷ μου πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τῇ χάριτι τοῦ θεοῦ τῇ δοθείσῃ ὑμῖν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,
verses.literal: I thank the God of mine always concerning you for the grace the of God which having been given you in Christ Jesus
verses.dgt: I thank my God always concerning you for the grace of God that was given to you in Christ Jesus,

verses.greek: ὅτι ἐν παντὶ ἐπλουτίσθητε ἐν αὐτῷ, ἐν παντὶ λόγῳ καὶ πάσῃ γνώσει,
verses.literal: for in everything you have been enriched in Him in all speech and in all knowledge
verses.dgt: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge,

verses.greek: καθὼς τὸ μαρτύριον τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐβεβαιώθη ἐν ὑμῖν,
verses.literal: even as the testimony the about Christ was confirmed in you
verses.dgt: just as the testimony of Christ was confirmed among you,

verses.greek: ὥστε ὑμᾶς μὴ ὑστερεῖσθαι ἐν μηδενὶ χαρίσματι, ἀπεκδεχομένους τὴν ἀποκάλυψιν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ·
verses.literal: so as for you not to be lacking in not one gift eagerly awaiting the revelation of the Lord of us Jesus Christ
verses.dgt: so that you are not lacking in any gift as you eagerly await the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.greek: ὃς καὶ βεβαιώσει ὑμᾶς ἕως τέλους ἀνεγκλήτους ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.literal: who also will sustain you to the end blameless in the day of the Lord of us Jesus Christ.
verses.dgt: who will also confirm you to the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.greek: πιστὸς ὁ θεὸς διʼ οὗ ἐκλήθητε εἰς κοινωνίαν τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν.
verses.literal: Faithful is the God through whom you were called into fellowship with the Son of Him Jesus Christ the Lord of us.
verses.dgt: God is faithful, through whom you were called into fellowship with his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.greek: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, διὰ τοῦ ὀνόματος τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἵνα τὸ αὐτὸ λέγητε πάντες, καὶ μὴ ᾖ ἐν ὑμῖν σχίσματα, ἦτε δὲ κατηρτισμένοι ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ νοῒ καὶ ἐν τῇ αὐτῇ γνώμῃ.
verses.literal: I exhort now you brothers through the name of the Lord of us Jesus Christ that the same thing you may speak all and not there may be among you divisions you may be however knit together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
verses.dgt: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters, through the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you all say the same thing and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

verses.greek: ἐδηλώθη γάρ μοι περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοί μου, ὑπὸ τῶν Χλόης ὅτι ἔριδες ἐν ὑμῖν εἰσιν.
verses.literal: It was shown for to me concerning you brothers of mine by those of Chloe that quarrels among you there are.
verses.dgt: For it was made clear to me concerning you, my brothers and sisters, by those of Chloe, that there are quarrels among you.

verses.greek: λέγω δὲ τοῦτο ὅτι ἕκαστος ὑμῶν λέγει· Ἐγὼ μέν εἰμι Παύλου, Ἐγὼ δὲ Ἀπολλῶ, Ἐγὼ δὲ Κηφᾶ, Ἐγὼ δὲ Χριστοῦ.
verses.literal: I mean now this that each of you says I myself indeed am of Paul I myself however of Apollos I myself however of Cephas I myself however of Christ.
verses.dgt: What I mean is this: each of you says, “I am of Paul,” or “I of Apollos,” or “I of Cephas,” or “I of Christ.”

verses.greek: μεμέρισται ὁ Χριστός; μὴ Παῦλος ἐσταυρώθη ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν, ἢ εἰς τὸ ὄνομα Παύλου ἐβαπτίσθητε;
verses.literal: Has been divided the Christ? Surely not Paul was crucified for you? Or into the name of Paul were you baptized?
verses.dgt: Has Christ been divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?

verses.greek: εὐχαριστῶ ὅτι οὐδένα ὑμῶν ἐβάπτισα εἰ μὴ Κρίσπον καὶ Γάϊον,
verses.literal: I thank that no one of you I baptized only except Crispus and Gaius
verses.dgt: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,

verses.greek: ἵνα μή τις εἴπῃ ὅτι εἰς τὸ ἐμὸν ὄνομα ἐβαπτίσθητε·
verses.literal: so that not anyone may say that into the my name you were baptized.
verses.dgt: so that no one may say that you were baptized into my name.

verses.greek: ἐβάπτισα δὲ καὶ τὸν Στεφανᾶ οἶκον· λοιπὸν οὐκ οἶδα εἴ τινα ἄλλον ἐβάπτισα.
verses.literal: I baptized now also the of Stephanas household as to the rest not I know whether any other I baptized.
verses.dgt: I also baptized the household of Stephanas; beyond that, I do not know whether I baptized anyone else.

verses.greek: οὐ γὰρ ἀπέστειλέν με Χριστὸς βαπτίζειν ἀλλὰ εὐαγγελίζεσθαι, οὐκ ἐν σοφίᾳ λόγου, ἵνα μὴ κενωθῇ ὁ σταυρὸς τοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.literal: Not for sent me Christ to baptize but to evangelise not in wisdom of discourse that not may be emptied of power the cross of the Christ.
verses.dgt: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to proclaim good news—not with wisdom of speech, so that the cross of Christ might not be emptied.

verses.greek: Ὁ λόγος γὰρ ὁ τοῦ σταυροῦ τοῖς μὲν ἀπολλυμένοις μωρία ἐστίν, τοῖς δὲ σῳζομένοις ἡμῖν δύναμις θεοῦ ἐστιν.
verses.literal: The message for the of the cross to those indeed perishing foolishness is to those however being saved to us power of God it is.
verses.dgt: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

verses.greek: γέγραπται γάρ· Ἀπολῶ τὴν σοφίαν τῶν σοφῶν, καὶ τὴν σύνεσιν τῶν συνετῶν ἀθετήσω.
verses.literal: It has been written for: I will destroy the wisdom of the wise and the intelligence of the intelligent I will frustrate.
verses.dgt: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and I will set aside the understanding of the understanding.”

verses.greek: ποῦ σοφός; ποῦ γραμματεύς; ποῦ συζητητὴς τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου; οὐχὶ ἐμώρανεν ὁ θεὸς τὴν σοφίαν τοῦ κόσμου;
verses.literal: Where is the wise? Where the scribe? Where the debater of the age this? Surely has made foolish the God the wisdom of the world
verses.dgt: Where is the wise person? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?

verses.greek: ἐπειδὴ γὰρ ἐν τῇ σοφίᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἔγνω ὁ κόσμος διὰ τῆς σοφίας τὸν θεόν, εὐδόκησεν ὁ θεὸς διὰ τῆς μωρίας τοῦ κηρύγματος σῶσαι τοὺς πιστεύοντας.
verses.literal: Since for in the wisdom the of God not knew the world through the wisdom the God was pleased the God through the foolishness of the proclamation to save those believing
verses.dgt: For since, in the wisdom of God, the world through wisdom did not know God, God was pleased through the foolishness of the proclamation to save those who believe.

verses.greek: ἐπειδὴ καὶ Ἰουδαῖοι σημεῖα αἰτοῦσιν καὶ Ἕλληνες σοφίαν ζητοῦσιν·
verses.literal: Seeing that both Jews signs ask for and Greeks wisdom seek
verses.dgt: For Jews ask for signs and Greeks seek wisdom,

verses.greek: ἡμεῖς δὲ κηρύσσομεν Χριστὸν ἐσταυρωμένον, Ἰουδαίοις μὲν σκάνδαλον ἔθνεσιν δὲ μωρίαν,
verses.literal: we ourselves however preach Christ crucified to the Jews indeed a stumbling block to Gentiles however foolishness
verses.dgt: but we proclaim Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles,

verses.greek: αὐτοῖς δὲ τοῖς κλητοῖς, Ἰουδαίοις τε καὶ Ἕλλησιν, Χριστὸν θεοῦ δύναμιν καὶ θεοῦ σοφίαν.
verses.literal: to them however to those called Jews both and to Greeks Christ of God the power and of God the wisdom.
verses.dgt: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.

verses.greek: ὅτι τὸ μωρὸν τοῦ θεοῦ σοφώτερον τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐστίν, καὶ τὸ ἀσθενὲς τοῦ θεοῦ ἰσχυρότερον τῶν ἀνθρώπων.
verses.literal: For the foolishness the of God wiser the than men is and the weakness the of God stronger the than men
verses.dgt: For the foolish thing of God is wiser than people, and the weak thing of God is stronger than people.

verses.greek: Βλέπετε γὰρ τὴν κλῆσιν ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοί, ὅτι οὐ πολλοὶ σοφοὶ κατὰ σάρκα, οὐ πολλοὶ δυνατοί, οὐ πολλοὶ εὐγενεῖς·
verses.literal: Consider for the calling of you brothers that not many wise according to flesh were not many powerful not many of noble birth
verses.dgt: For consider your calling, brothers and sisters: not many were wise according to the flesh, not many powerful, not many of noble birth.

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ τὰ μωρὰ τοῦ κόσμου ἐξελέξατο ὁ θεός, ἵνα καταισχύνῃ τοὺς σοφούς, καὶ τὰ ἀσθενῆ τοῦ κόσμου ἐξελέξατο ὁ θεός, ἵνα καταισχύνῃ τὰ ἰσχυρά,
verses.literal: But the foolish things of the world has chosen the God that He may shame the wise and the weak things of the world chose the God that He may shame the strong
verses.dgt: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise, and God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong,

verses.greek: καὶ τὰ ἀγενῆ τοῦ κόσμου καὶ τὰ ἐξουθενημένα ἐξελέξατο ὁ θεός, τὰ μὴ ὄντα, ἵνα τὰ ὄντα καταργήσῃ,
verses.literal: and the low-born of the world and the things despised chose the God the things not being that the things being He may annul
verses.dgt: and God chose the lowborn things of the world and the despised things, the things that are not, to bring to nothing the things that are,

verses.greek: ὅπως μὴ καυχήσηται πᾶσα σὰρξ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.literal: so that not may boast all flesh before the God.
verses.dgt: so that no flesh may boast before God.

verses.greek: ἐξ αὐτοῦ δὲ ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, ὃς ἐγενήθη σοφία ἡμῖν ἀπὸ θεοῦ, δικαιοσύνη τε καὶ ἁγιασμὸς καὶ ἀπολύτρωσις,
verses.literal: Out of Him however you yourselves are in Christ Jesus who has been made wisdom unto us from God righteousness and also sanctification and redemption
verses.dgt: But from him you are in Christ Jesus, who became for us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification and redemption,

verses.greek: ἵνα καθὼς γέγραπται· Ὁ καυχώμενος ἐν κυρίῳ καυχάσθω.
verses.literal: in order that even as it has been written: The one boasting in the Lord he should boast.
verses.dgt: so that, just as it is written, “The one who boasts, let that one boast in the Lord.”
